Totally get watching your budget—pet food choices can feel like a juggling act.

Here are a few lower-commitment, wallet-friendly ways to try us:

Try samples first: Grab our Variety Pack on Chewy or Amazon, or single packs at PetSmart, so your pup can taste-test without starting a subscription.
Skip subscriptions (for now): You can buy our full recipes directly from PetSmart, Amazon, or Chewy instead of jumping into a recurring plan.
Get a personalized quote: Your subscription price depends on things like your dog’s age, weight, activity level, recipes, and your ZIP code. Share those details with our Pet Support team and they can tell you what your exact cost would look like.
Ask about discounts: If you’re a First Responder or Military Veteran, our Pet Support team can help you apply for a discount on Nom Nom orders.

If you need more help, you can ask to speak to a customer representative agent.
